# HabitFlow

> HabitFlow is a premium editorial habit tracker for daily rituals, streaks, and intentional routines.

## Product

- Name: HabitFlow
- URL: https://habitflow.indevs.in/
- Category: Web application / habit tracker / productivity
- Author: Prashant Khuva
- Tech Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Redux Toolkit, Framer Motion
- Price: Free (USD $0)
- Launch Date: 2026

## What it does

HabitFlow helps users cultivate daily rituals through a calm, editorial interface. Users track habits (called rituals), build streaks, view consistency heatmaps and weekly charts, add reflection notes, and archive completed habits. It is designed for intentional living — focused on clarity, consistency, and visual feedback rather than gamification or pressure.

## Key features

- Daily ritual and habit tracking with boolean and measurable habits
- Streak analytics and consistency insights
- Progress heatmaps and weekly completion charts
- Reflection notes on completed rituals
- Time-of-day insights (morning/afternoon/evening)
- Habit categories: Health, Fitness, Learning, Productivity, Mindfulness
- Editorial, distraction-free UI designed for intentional living
- Responsive mobile-first design with bottom navigation
- Swipe navigation between main routes
- Dark mode support
- Full authentication system (JWT cookie-based)

- Habit stacking techniques

- Identity-based habit change

- Two-minute rule and tiny habits

- Weekly review practices
